title: Grok.me public project inspection
scope: Twelve additional candidate projects selected for fit with ongoing work. Discovered through maker-linked public showcase listings. This is a shortlist, with no inference about the broader population.

evidence_levels.exercised: A named UI behavior was directly exercised and observed.
evidence_levels.page: Read the public app interface. Any additional maker-directory features are explicitly attributed to the listing.
evidence_levels.listing: Read the public maker-linked listing. The app homepage returned HTTP 403 to a direct request in this pass.

reuse: No individual app reuse license was established. Links to original posts are taken from the directory; the posts were not independently verified. Adaptation ideas and proposed checks are suggestions for the user's projects.

entries.name: Prompt Injection Scanner
entries.observed_or_attributed: The app displays its weighted text categories, score bands and a Download HTML control.
entries.proposed_application: Use the score as an advisory flag. Keep it outside command authorization.
entries.proposed_check: In local CORTAC fixtures, hold the warrant fixed and vary the text. A score change must leave approval, revocation and commit outcomes unchanged.

entries.name: Planning and Development
entries.observed_or_attributed: The demo notebook describes assistant access to read and edit. The maker-linked listing describes a read-without-editing option.
entries.proposed_application: Adapt this as a visible permission for reading a decision record and a separate permission for changing it.
entries.proposed_check: Run a synthetic read-only review, produce a suggested change, withdraw edit authority and check the original bytes and audit trail.

entries.name: Chance Lab
project_matches: Evaluating AI Claims in Life Sciences
entries.observed_or_attributed: Displays observed counts against a chosen coin or dice model and resets the tally on a new coin weight.
entries.proposed_application: Pair a predeclared baseline with observed outcomes in the workshop or study viewer.
entries.observed_check: With heads weight set to 100%, running 20 trials returned 20 heads, 0 tails, and a displayed gap of 0.0 percentage points. The explanation still cautioned about the small sample. Use a separate explanation for deterministic settings.

entries.name: Mars Colony
entries.observed_or_attributed: The public page shows landing status and keyboard building controls. The listing describes terrain, habitat and solar blocks and browser saves.
entries.proposed_application: Use the landing-to-construction sequence to introduce life support and energy.
entries.proposed_check: Try one starter habitat. Show its power and oxygen budgets before placement, after placement and after a save/reload.

entries.name: Orrery
entries.observed_or_attributed: The interface offers body selection, time controls and a disclosed compression of distances and sizes. Orbital tilts are exaggerated on screen.
entries.proposed_application: Use a readable overview beside a mission readout in physical units.
entries.proposed_check: Zoom or change the display scale while keeping the same simulated instant. The numerical Earth–Mars range and derived signal delay should stay fixed.

entries.name: Night Roadster
entries.observed_or_attributed: The public game lists chase, cockpit and orbit cameras. Its listing describes speed and g-force displays.
entries.proposed_application: Display one recorded drive through different cameras with a shared telemetry strip.
entries.proposed_check: Replay one lap with each camera. Sector times and acceleration samples should agree across views.

entries.name: Innerverse
project_matches: Evaluating AI Claims in Life Sciences
entries.observed_or_attributed: A guided tour and free exploration take the reader through seven magnification stops from a cell toward DNA.
entries.proposed_application: Organize a PGx teaching case from gene to variant to interpretation to a cited guideline.
entries.proposed_check: Ask a learner to identify which statement is a molecular observation and which relies on clinical evidence.

entries.name: Candle Crypt Racing
entries.observed_or_attributed: The menu separates garage, circuit selection and championship play across 15 circuits.
entries.proposed_application: Use its menu organization for a track, weather and vehicle selection flow.
entries.proposed_check: Time how long a first-time driver takes to start the same track under two weather settings.

entries.name: AERIS
entries.observed_or_attributed: A gravity strength slider, manipulation modes and preset scenes share a single public control panel.
entries.proposed_application: Provide named local stress cases beside the rover simulation controls.
entries.proposed_check: Reset the same seeded scene and compare run traces and units under two gravity settings. The demo's dynamics were not benchmarked.

entries.name: THRUST
entries.observed_or_attributed: The maker-linked catalog describes a hangar grid, vehicle mass properties, test flights and a turnaround-cost panel.
entries.proposed_application: Connect a chosen vehicle configuration to its test result and operating cost.
entries.proposed_check: Change one benign payload item locally and track its mass delta from the configuration screen into the test receipt.

entries.name: RD-62 Rational-Duplex
entries.observed_or_attributed: The catalog describes a two-sided virtual slide rule showing algebra and rational-geometry quantities, with SVG or DXF plate export.
entries.proposed_application: Give learners an inspectable geometric construction and an exact numerical answer beside it.
entries.proposed_check: Use a 3–4–5 triangle with squared lengths 9, 16 and 25, and compare instrument readings with exact arithmetic.

entries.name: Floor
entries.observed_or_attributed: The catalog describes an on-device, single-question poll with a running tally.
entries.proposed_application: Show a public consultation tally as one input alongside quorum, dissent and the formal decision.
entries.proposed_check: Use synthetic votes for which a majority supports a proposal while the quorum requirement remains unmet. Show both facts.
